text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Fine Motion taking a
leisurely
stroll by the fields and admiring
the flora.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The grass and trees here really
are
different to Ireland's.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, a ladybug. Hehe, you're the same
wherever
you are.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fine,
I'd appreciate it if you didn't touch
them.
They're quite delicate.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I do apologize. Did I scare you,
little

ladybug?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I must say, I'm quite amazed by you,
Flash! You
know them so well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well, I am in the lower rungs of the Ladybug Conservation Society.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
They're pleasant to the eye and keep
plant life safe from those pesky aphids.
It's only fair to pay
them at least a little
respect.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. So in other words, these
bugs are the
knights protecting the
field!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If they're the knights, I guess that makes
you their
commander?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Me? A commander?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you are Eishin Flash, Knight
Commander of the Ladybug Army! When
the Aphid Brigade was
plotting yet
another attack on the field...

text_block_list.name: Aphid Brigade
text_block_list.text: Creep, creep...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, in formation! We will put a
stop to
these foes once and for all!

text_block_list.name: Ladybug Knights
text_block_list.text: Scuttle, scuttle!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just like that! What do you think? Does
it not
sound wonderful?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well... I don't think I would be in charge
of
fending off a large-scale aphid
attack, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I would consider it a great honor if my

conservation efforts earned me such a
title.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right? From this day forth, you are to be
known
as Knight Commander!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, I will now announce your first
official
task as commander. Have you
steeled yourself for
the challenge?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Yes, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Would you introduce me to all the noble
knights
guarding the academy's field? I
have only met
one so far.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That's a simple request. I'll gladly
introduce them
to you.
